run_EfmInference: run the EfmInference class to process per-snippet data through a model and save 3D OBB predictions
create_EfmInference: create an EfmInference instance with a streamer, model, output directory, device, and optional obb_only flag
save_output_EfmInference: save per-snippet 3D OBB predictions and occupancy tensors to disk using the save_output method
save_tensor_EfmInference: save a PyTorch tensor to a .pt file with an optional index using the save_tensor method
review_EfmInference_run: review the EfmInference run method that iterates over batches, runs model inference, and saves scene-level OBBs
